purpose: Test one low-load-only resident-backlog correction: retain V11 exactly, add the V15 exact-function load weight of 0.05, and remove only its same-window projected component because projected placements are already represented by the frozen same-function term.

decision_scope_evidence.interpretation: Even weight 0.05 changed almost every populated initializer window because the prior function-load signal added the same-window projected count. That projected count overlaps the separately frozen same-function spreading term and obscures the intended current resident-backlog signal.

diagnostic_basis.single_change: Relative to V15, set only NASH_OPERATIONAL_FUNCTION_PROJECTED_LOAD_WEIGHT from its backward-compatible default 1.0 to 0.0. The exact-function term therefore contains only the pre-window running-container request count. Every V11 proxy weight, unrestricted initializer rule, paper-utility band, and 0.05 switch threshold remains frozen.
diagnostic_basis.termination_rule: V19 is the sole resident-only correction. If it fails either low first-rank gate, the exact-function-load branch is closed rather than subdividing its weight or projected component further.

eligibility: all V19 low reference builds and runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
low geometric-mean throughput and QPR ratios versus first-version NSESche are each at least 0.98
low mean throughput and QPR each rank first against frozen E01-E03 baselines
frozen V8 middle/high retain first-place throughput and QPR
combined latency and cost geometric-mean ratios are each at most 1.10
development_screen.selection_rule: V19 either passes every combined gate or confirmation remains sealed

confirmation.closure_requirement: For every load, optimized NSESche must rank first in mean fixed-window throughput and QPR against frozen E11-E20 baselines; otherwise report not closed without seed deletion.
